content: Yook ambo bi ye karub yeman. Dewid ye yook.

content.text: Kwane dabab kandebka Yarimanbed inandubdok,
kwane Yekob ye God yaningko yaambed dorondarubdok.
Yembed kurikuri boyambiwoombed awabdok,
kwane aangko Saiyon yaambed eb nen angkumonok.
Ebbed God yaa bangkanimaab korem kuu yembed ika meenok,
kwane ebbed dingkan aye nengke agedmo kere baeb koni yeman bangkanimaab kuu yembed ee yimin andok.Selah
Eb niindem aombed komo yaa dowakeniib kerewen kuu yembed kabdok,
kwane inamen ongmenabewen korem kuu yembed ongmoko anam kerok.
Ebbed bondan nangme burudande doraneeb kuu kube komkenub,
burudandewen kii andi ye ebkad barad kankoonenub nub God ewaningko yaambed kubanuub.
Yiib kaamoni korem kuu Yarimanbed ee yimin ande awandok.
Ne nekaad Yarimanbed kinoonman kuu ye bondan yaa nen burudande angka kowimaan,
kwane Ewen karadmo arimbed ye kinoonman yaa inandimaan,
ye dingki wiwi ye aromkono, nen burudande angka kowi ye aromkono kumbed kui.
Yena kuu ana nangmidan seriot arimbed dobere nangmimaib kuu nub yaa awandaniib ande meedmimaib,
yena kuu ana nangmidan hoos arimbed dibere nangmimaib kuu nub yaa awandaniib ande meedmimaib,
kumban nub kuu Yariman nub God kumbed nub yaa awandaneen ande meedmimaub.
Yi kuu ben kubunaneene kirobaniib,
kumban nub kuu yaro dembenub kangdommo dobaranuub.
O Yariman, king kuu nen burudande angka kowe!
Nub baandubka inande!
